feeds.title: Baskin-Robbins Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1945 in Glendale, California, Baskin-Robbinshas grown to become the world's largest chain of ice creamspecialty shops while staying true to its neighborhood ice creamparlor values. Baskin-Robbins continues to be an innovation leader in the ice cream industry.

feeds.title: Pierre's Ice Cream Blog
feeds.description: Our blog covers everything going on at Pierre's: Entertaining & Fun Stuff, Nutrition & Health and Recipes!

feeds.title: Gemma's Bigger Bolder Baking
feeds.description: I'm Gemma Stafford, a professional chef originally from Ireland, and I'm passionate about sharing my years of experience to show you how to make simple recipes with over-the-top results! Get 100+ easy homemade ice cream recipes and frozen desserts! Find ice cream, popsicles, frozen yogurt, cakes and more in your frozen dessert destination.

feeds.title: Colleen's Ice Cream Blog
feeds.description: Colleen started this as a silly project to see how many ice cream parlors she could reach in one year. Soon she discovered that each ice cream parlor is unique and interesting. Many are a reflection of the town in which they are located in these places.

feeds.title: Ice Cream Nation
feeds.description: Ice Cream Nation is devoted to ice cream and related frozen desserts in all its fascinating forms and variations. A main objective is to encourage, promote and share information on the making of home-made ice cream.

feeds.title: G.S. Gelato
feeds.description: .S. Gelato crafts authentic Italian gelato made with only the finest imported ingredients. From wholesale gelato to private label gelato, G.S. Gelato has what you need.

feeds.title: FatBoy Ice Cream Blog
feeds.description: Casper's Ice Cream continues to innovate and provide the finest quality of frozen products including their newest addition, Active D'Lites. Active D'Lites are a delicious, good for you ice cream bar depending on the flavor and coated with fine European Style Chocolate.

feeds.title: Giani's Ice Cream Blog
feeds.description: Giani's Ice Cream is a legendary ice cream brand that has been delighting taste buds since 1956. This iconic ice cream brand is known for its exceptional taste, a wide variety of flavors, and diverse menu. Over the years, Giani's has become a household name for dessert lovers, and its outlets are present in various parts of the country.

feeds.title: The Novice Chef
feeds.description: Jessica Segarra is the girl behind The Novice Chef. She is a self taught, sugar addict who taught herself how to survive in the kitchen.She is writer of two cookbook, first is Mini Donuts and her second cookbook is Cereal Sweets & Treats.

feeds.title: Nature's Organic Ice Cream Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about serving organic ice cream made from natural ingredients and making unbelievable combinations of ice cream with a variety of unique exotic, classic, and vegan flavors. Nature's Organic Ice Cream is a Fremont based natural and organic ice cream brand. We use highest quality organic ingredients to make natural and artisanal ice cream.

feeds.title: Ice Cream Central Ice Cream Inspiration
feeds.description: I'm Melissa, the creator of Ice Cream Inspiration. You'll love my recipes, home organization challenge, and amazing makeovers.

feeds.title: Ice Cream University
feeds.description: Ice cream business seminars, ice cream consulting, ingredients, books and resources for those in or starting in the ice cream business.

feeds.title: Praline's Ice cream Blog
feeds.description: Learn all about delicious ice cream and other treats from the Praline's Ice Cream blog! Founded in 1984 by Donna and the late Joe Torre, Praline's Ice Cream has been Connecticut's Original Super Premium Ice Cream maker for over 25 years.

feeds.title: Creamish
feeds.description: Discover a huge selection of ice cream recipes that are easy to make and taste unbelievable. Learn about ice cream, sorbet, sherbet, kulfi and much more.

feeds.title: If the Spoon Fits
feeds.description: I'm Lindsay. I love eating, making, photographing, and writing about ice cream. I'm so glad you stopped by!

feeds.title: Ice-cream-recipes.com Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to 'A Blog of Ice Cream' by Shelagh Caudle, Editor of www.ice-cream-recipes.com, one of the world's most popular websites for information on ice cream making, ice cream recipes, ice cream sundaes, ice cream cones, ice cream making tips and news.

feeds.title: The Big Muddy Ice Cream Blog
feeds.description: Just two girls who love ice cream.

feeds.title: On Second Scoop
feeds.description: Second Scoop, is a site dedicated to frozen treats. A blog that has cataloged over 1500 ice creams, frozen yogurts, gelatos and any other frozen treats.
